title: CellFactor: factorizing bulk-derived survival risk into cell-type composition and within-cell-type state
description: Source code of CellFactor, which estimates cell-type composition and within-cell-type program states from bulk transcriptomes and factorizes survival risk into additive composition-by-state contributions. The archive contains the model definition (model.py), the training script (train.py), the analysis scripts used for the figures and tables of the paper (analysis/), and the package versions used (requirements.txt).
